title: Round 29 (F335): Main-init window creation catalog - hero HUD builder 0x427600 + frame fns 0x419110/0x419350 + window ctor registry
objective: Produce a complete window-id -> ctor -> object-offset catalog for the main initialization / frame dispatch region 0x4190xx-0x428xxx of MIR3.EXE (EI 3.0 original client), cross-referenced against previously decoded windows (0xC option window, id15 notify window, chat window).
question: Which windows does the original client create at main-init, with which ctor, at which object offset, with which frame id / geometry / label strings? What is the shared factory helper pattern?
method: Static disassembly of MIR3.EXE .text (raw file bytes, .text VA = file_offset + 0x400000) with capstone (CS_ARCH_X86/CS_MODE_32). Caller scan for E8 targets via regex on raw bytes; immediate string push scan in 0x47A000-0x918FD4; string decode via pefile get_memory_mapped_image() GBK; IAT name resolution via pefile DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT. cdecl arg order: rightmost push = arg1.
